verdict.rationale: Pipecat ships an official open-source Python framework, `pipecat-ai` on PyPI, which a runtime probe confirmed installs and imports without a key. It also documents Pipecat Clients, a family of official SDKs for web and mobile with prebuilt React components, so developers build directly against first-party SDKs. missing for 10: an official client SDK for the Pipecat Cloud REST API (only a downloadable OpenAPI spec for generating clients), hands-on corroboration of the web/mobile client SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Pipecat Clients are a family of SDKs that connect users to your Pipecat agents through web and mobile applications.
Pre-built React components for voice AI interfaces.
Open source Python framework for building voice and multimodal AI pipelines.
pypi pipecat-ai 1.8.1 (BSD-2 OSS) installs and `import pipecat` succeeds with no key
